provenance.source: curated move catalog and character guides from budok-ai

summary.game_plan: Cowboy is a versatile all-rounder with tools for every range.
tips: At close range (<50 units): Pommel (h_reach 28, fast, safe), Grab (50), VSlash (68, high damage), 3Combo (48). Mix attacks and grabs.
At mid range (50-110 units): HSlash2 (h_reach 109), Stinger (82 + lunge), AnkleCutter (92). Cowboy's sword normals are excellent here.
At long range (110+ units): LightningSliceNeutral (h_reach 147, travels through air), Brandish → Shoot (fullscreen gun), Lasso (250, long-range grab).

Movement: When >150 units, use Walk Forward or Dash to close into sword range. Super Dash covers big gaps with armor. Don't spam LightningSlice from fullscreen — close distance and use higher-damage melee instead.
Defense: SpotDodge (invuln frames 5-7, fast recovery) and Foresight are strong.
Cowboy wins by mixing all three ranges. Don't camp one distance.

1000Cuts.summary: 1000 Cuts — projectile buff super, enhances all attacks. Costs meter.

1000CutsEnd.summary: End 1000 Cuts buff early with Fatal Cut.

3Combo.summary: 3-hit combo — automatic multi-hit string. Good after Pommel.

AirGrab.loses_to: loses to air attacks, requires both players airborne

AnkleCutter.summary: Ankle Cutter — low sweep, hits crouching opponents.

BackSlash.summary: Backward slash — retreat while attacking. Safe spacing tool.
BackSlash.loses_to: lower damage than committed attacks, gives up position

Brandish.summary: Quick Draw stance entry. Unlocks Shoot, PointBlank, PistolWhip, and ShootDodge next turn. Use this to access gun moves.
Brandish.loses_to: costs a turn to set up, does no damage itself

ChargeDash.summary: Super Dash: a short wind-up (see its frames) followed by a long dash forward. Best for crossing large distances; beats backdashes.
ChargeDash.loses_to: attacks and throws during the wind-up; punishable if predicted

Dash.summary: Dash: a quick forward hop; actionable early (see its frames). Use it to close distance fast.
Dash.loses_to: well-timed attacks and anti-airs; covers less ground than Super Dash

DashBackward.summary: Dash Back: quick retreat. It cannot end early while the opponent's forward dash (or another move that beats backdashes) is running.
DashBackward.beats: close-range pressure and throws by moving out of range; creates space
DashBackward.loses_to: forward dashes that chase it; gives up stage space and can corner you

DashForward.summary: Dash Forward: quick grounded dash toward the opponent; the payload (0-100) sets how far. While it runs, an opponent's backdash cannot end early. Use it to get into attack or throw range, then attack next turn.
DashForward.beats: backdashes; closes the gap so your attacks can connect
DashForward.loses_to: attacks timed against your approach; predictable if repeated

DefensiveBurst.summary: Burst: an invulnerable reversal that knocks the opponent away; your way out of combos and pressure. Spends your burst stock (at most one at a time); the burst meter refills over time and faster when you take damage.
DefensiveBurst.loses_to: being baited (the opponent blocks or backs off and punishes); afterwards you have no burst until the meter refills

DoubleJump.summary: Double Jump — second jump while airborne. Changes your air trajectory. Use to extend airtime, dodge anti-airs, or reposition in the air.
DoubleJump.beats: dodges anti-airs by changing trajectory, extends air control.
DoubleJump.loses_to: uses your air action, can't double jump again.

Fall.summary: Fall — drop from the air quickly. Use to land faster and become actionable sooner instead of floating. Good after a whiffed air attack or to bait anti-airs.
Fall.beats: lands quickly to act sooner, baits anti-airs that expect you to stay airborne.

FastTeleport.summary: Teleport — instant repositioning super. Costs meter.

Foresight.summary: Place temporal afterimage marker. Can teleport back to it later.
Foresight.loses_to: does no damage, costs a turn to set up

ForwardDashFollowup.summary: Follow-up attack after a forward dash. Good for closing distance and attacking.

Grab.summary: Throw: grabs a grounded opponent. Beats blocking and parrying. Very short range: its box reaches only about 20 in front of your center (see its measured reach), so with the opponent's body you need a center distance of about 30 or less. Get in first with Dash Forward.
Grab.beats: blocking and parrying opponents who are touching you
Grab.loses_to: any attack that comes out first, jumps, and stepping or dashing back; whiffs at even a little distance

GunReel.summary: Pull thrown gun back with lasso.

GunThrow.summary: Throw your gun as a projectile. Loses gun access until retrieved.
GunThrow.loses_to: loses gun access, need GunReel to recover

Guntrick.summary: Gun Trick — counter-parry with gun. Counters attacks with a shot.

HSlash2.loses_to: loses to blocking (punishable), slow startup vs fast attacks

Holster.summary: Holster gun — exit Quick Draw stance.

Impale.summary: Impale — very high damage commitment. Huge risk, huge reward.
Impale.beats: blocking opponents, massive damage if it lands
Impale.loses_to: extremely slow, any attack beats it, huge whiff punish

ImpaleTeleport.summary: Teleport Impale variant — teleports behind opponent regardless of distance.

InstantCancel.summary: Cancel current move animation instantly. Costs meter.

IzunaDrop.loses_to: very slow, easily interrupted by any attack

Jump.summary: Jump — become airborne. JumpArc payload controls trajectory (x: horizontal direction, y: height). Startup 2-5 ticks. Short jumps actionable in ~10 ticks, high jumps ~15. Avoids grabs and ground attacks. Enables aerial attacks on landing.
Jump.beats: avoids ALL grabs and ground-only attacks. Repositions vertically. Use to approach over projectiles or escape grab pressure.
Jump.loses_to: predictable landing trajectory, vulnerable to anti-airs (UpwardSwipe). Aerial blocking is weaker than ground blocking (+2 block disadvantage).

Lasso.summary: Lasso — thrown rope, leads to Pull or Izuna Drop on hit. Long-range grab.
Lasso.loses_to: loses to attacks (can be hit during throw), slow

LightningSlice.summary: Lightning Slice — directional aerial slash, dashes 120 units. Effective range ~250 units. Loses to blocking, punishable on whiff.
LightningSlice.beats: opponents in the air, good at range
LightningSlice.loses_to: loses to blocking, punishable on whiff, airborne so vulnerable to anti-airs

LightningSliceCancel.summary: Lightning Slice cancel — dashes 120 units, faster recovery, less damage. Effective range ~250 units.
LightningSliceCancel.loses_to: low damage, still loses to blocking

LightningSliceNeutral.summary: Lightning Slice neutral — dashes 120 units through air then slashes. Effective range ~250 units total (120 travel + 147 hitbox). Will NOT reach at 300+ units.
LightningSliceNeutral.loses_to: loses to blocking and parry, punishable on whiff, predictable if overused

OffensiveBurst.summary: Burst Cancel: during your own combo, cancels your current attack so you can keep the combo going or reset pressure. Spends your burst stock (it refills over time).
OffensiveBurst.beats: opponents expecting the combo to end
OffensiveBurst.loses_to: nothing directly, but it spends the burst you may need to escape a combo later

ParryAfterWhiff.summary: Block after a whiffed attack. Same as ParryHigh but in recovery.

ParryHigh.summary: Block high/mid attacks. Parry timing count sets active parry frames (1-20).
ParryHigh.loses_to: loses to grabs, does no damage

ParrySuper.summary: Push Block — costs meter, creates distance on block.

PistolWhip.summary: Pistol Whip — multi-hit gun-butt attack. Requires Quick Draw stance.
PistolWhip.beats: close-range pressure, chip damage through block

PointBlank.summary: Point Blank — close-range devastating shot. Requires Quick Draw stance.
PointBlank.loses_to: very short range, requires Brandish stance first, costs bullet

Pommel.summary: Pommel strike — fast, safe on block. Combos into 3Combo or HSlash2.
Pommel.beats: beats grabs due to speed, safe pressure starter

QuickerDraw.summary: Faster Quick Draw variant. Unlocks gun moves like Brandish.

Roll.summary: Dodge — invincible roll. Has invincibility frames that avoid all attacks. Good for escaping pressure or dodging predictable attacks. Direction is usually fixed.
Roll.beats: attacks (invincible frames), projectiles, repositions while safe.
Roll.loses_to: vulnerable after invincibility ends, loses to delayed attacks and grabs.

Shoot2.summary: Shoot — fires revolver bullet. Costs 1 bullet. Requires Quick Draw stance (use Brandish first).
Shoot2.loses_to: limited bullets, requires Brandish stance first

ShootDodge2.summary: Shoot while dodging — evasive gunshot. Requires Quick Draw stance.
ShootDodge2.loses_to: limited bullets, requires Brandish stance first

SpotDodge.summary: Spot Dodge — quick stationary dodge, fast recovery.
SpotDodge.beats: avoids attacks without moving, fast recovery allows punish
SpotDodge.loses_to: loses to grabs, loses to delayed attacks

Stinger.summary: Stinger — forward lunge stab. Hitbox 82 + lunges forward ~60 units. Effective range ~140 units. Best mid-range poke but punishable on whiff.
Stinger.beats: opponents at mid range, good punish tool
Stinger.loses_to: very punishable on block or whiff, committed lunge

SuperJump.summary: Super Jump — high/far jump covering more distance than normal jump. JumpArc payload controls arc. Startup 5 ticks. Covers large horizontal and vertical distance. Use for big repositioning or escaping corner pressure.
SuperJump.beats: escapes pressure, covers large distance, avoids grabs and ground attacks.
SuperJump.loses_to: longer airtime makes landing predictable. Vulnerable to anti-airs.

Taunt.summary: Hustle/taunt — builds meter but leaves you vulnerable.
Taunt.loses_to: fully vulnerable during animation, punishable at any range

TechRoll.summary: Tech Dodge — invincible roll on knockdown. Use when knocked down to escape wakeup pressure. Repositions while invincible.
TechRoll.beats: avoids wakeup pressure (meaties, grabs on your wakeup).
TechRoll.loses_to: direction is predictable, opponent can read and chase.

TimeBullet.summary: Temporal Round — fires a time-frozen bullet. Costs meter.

TimeSplitter.summary: Time Splitter: super slash that hits once for heavy damage (200 base). Costs meter (see meter_bars).
TimeSplitter.beats: opponents who are open or far away
TimeSplitter.loses_to: blocking; punishable if blocked or whiffed

UpwardSwipe.summary: Upward Swipe — anti-air sword launch. Use when opponent is airborne.
UpwardSwipe.loses_to: short range, whiffs vs grounded opponents at distance

VSlash.summary: Vertical Slash — overhead sword swing, strong damage.

Wait.summary: Do nothing this turn. Low commitment, preserves options.
Wait.loses_to: gives up initiative, opponent acts freely

WhiffInstantCancel.summary: Cancel a whiffed move. Costs meter.
